diagnostics.rayMethod: conservative primary with finite-boundary and rail rescue
diagnostics.metric: primary + rescue rail march iterations; excludes normal and attribute field queries
diagnostics.stepCapKind: shared primary and rescue march iteration budget
diagnostics.hitEpsilon: kernel primary/rescue 0.00001m; grazing or non-boundary candidates require analytic recovery
diagnostics.stepRule: conservative primary with shared512 march-iteration budget; unresolved/grazing recovery uses exact finite structural boundaries and rail-only conservative tracing; no unsafe minimum step
diagnostics.missCondition: finite boundary tests rejected all candidates and rail interval exhausted geometrically; budget exhaustion remains unresolved
diagnostics.readback: exact Float32 primary and final MRT attachments

stageTimings.measurement: per-pass wallclock state setup and draw plus gl.finish and one-pixel readback from that pass target; not isolated GPU timer
stageTimings.interpretation: Each pass is synchronized by its own blocking one-pixel readback. Prior finish-only near-zero stage measurements are invalid and superseded. Stage times do not equal or replace the unsplit full-frame benchmark. Rescue runs only for primary status 3; other pixels use passthrough.
stageTimings.synchronizationReadback: one pixel per pass inside timing: RGBA/FLOAT from primary and rescue COLOR_ATTACHMENT0; RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE from default framebuffer for shade
stageTimings.readback: Full Float32 primary and final state attachments for status counts after the final measured frame; outside timing

reservedServiceVoid.evidence: R03/R05 authored reserve; not an observed core or lift

stairDomain.basis: whole polygon containment and segment crossings, not corner-only checks

partitionDomain.basis: whole polygon containment and segment crossings, not corner-only checks

distanceContract.outside: nonnegative conservative distance bound; exact primitive/curve exterior distances before CSG
distanceContract.inside: signed occupancy field, not universally exact interior distance
distanceContract.zeroSet: analytic constituent/CSG zero surfaces; touching solids can retain internal zeros, rejected by occupancy-transition tests; no sampled polygonal approximation
distanceContract.hitTolerance: field-value tolerance, not a universal Euclidean proximity certificate at CSG corners
distanceContract.unresolvedRule: step budget exhaustion must remain unresolved, never silently treated as a geometric miss
distanceContract.primaryTrace: up to 128 conservative evaluations with 10 micrometre field tolerance, occupancy-transition and grazing checks; unresolved candidates use analytic rescue within shared 512-distance-evaluation budget

compileProfile.firstDrawMeasurement: first full-frame draw plus gl.finish and one-pixel default-framebuffer readback; includes deferred driver work and target allocation, excludes prior queued work; not isolated GPU time

fieldDescriptorTexture.kind: analytic structural plane and finite-domain query records

compileProfile.rayProbeInterface: same primary/rescue interfaces and Float32 MRT transport as production render

renderer.renderer: WebGL2 direct analytic field: primary Float32 MRT, unresolved-only rescue, shared shade

scheduling.mode: on-demand latest-state coalescing; no animation loop or frame-rate claim
scheduling.timingMeaning: requestToDispatchStartMs is latest request to JavaScript dispatch start; dispatchWallMs is synchronous callback wall time, sometimes including driver work. Neither measures isolated GPU time or visible presentation latency.

gpuBackpressure.method: non-blocking WebGL2 fence; latest camera replaces queued intent; no GPU or presentation latency claim
